dogecoin.text: This time last year I only knew of $BTC, $LTC, $ETH, and $DOGE.  That’s it.  I had no idea the different ecosystems and the possibilities to making money here.   I didn’t even know #DeFi was a thing that existed.
Can we get another $DOGE to a dollar rally again?  I’ve never touched DOGE but it seems to get the people excited about the markets.
$Doge is getting shilled hard again.  Time to send it all.
